Slop EML · In development

EML previewer and converter

Preview, print and convert email files (.eml). Nothing uploaded.

Open now

Slop EML has these main features: Headers, HTML and plain text, with attachments; Remote images blocked, nothing loads from the network. It opens Email (.eml).

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop EML

  • Open an .eml email file
  • Convert an EML email to PDF
